perfil: Chaton is the sniper of White Cat Troupe. Though fond of close combat, in the end she chose a customized weapon as tall as herself, one that can only be used from a distance.

habilidades.b: Fires rapidly at the target, dealing DMG.

tpl.s: Fires rapidly at the target. Each shot deals ⟦0⟧ of ATK as Ignis Auto Attack DMG. Magazine contains 30 ammo. When Chaton is in the ⟨Evil Eye Unleashed⟩ state, upgrades Full-Auto Trigger (Auto Attack) to Dark Burst, each shot dealing ⟦1⟧ of ATK as Ignis Ultimate DMG and consuming no ammo.

habilidades.b: Tap: Chaton fires a laser at the target, inflicting Lock Mark and dealing DMG over time. Hold: Chaton throws Bouncing Bombs at the target, dealing AoE DMG. The Main Skill can trigger ⟨Ignis Mark⟩ and generate Conflagration.

tpl.s: Chaton uses different attack methods depending on whether the skill button is tapped or held. ⟦0⟧ activates ⟨Dark Ray⟩. Chaton fires a laser at the target, dealing ⟦1⟧ of ATK as Ignis Skill DMG and inflicting Dark Mark for 14s. Chaton deals ⟦2⟧ of ATK as Ignis Skill DMG to targets inflicted with Dark Mark every 2s. ⟦3⟧ activates ⟨Bouncing Kitty Bomb⟩. Chaton throws 2 Bouncing Bombs at the target, each dealing ⟦4⟧ of ATK as AoE Ignis Skill DMG. Bouncing Bombs then bounce to nearby targets, up to 5 times. Sniper Operation (Main Skill) can trigger ⟨Ignis Mark⟩ and generate Conflagration: deals ⟪0⟫ of ATK as Ignis Mark DMG.

habilidades.b: Rolls toward the target while firing, dealing DMG. The Support Skill can trigger ⟨Ignis Mark⟩ and generate Conflagration.

tpl.s: Rolls toward the target and fires Penetrating Bullets, penetrating the target and dealing ⟦0⟧ of ATK as Ignis Skill DMG. This action is performed 3 times in succession. Blitz Assault (Support Skill) can trigger ⟨Ignis Mark⟩ and generate Conflagration: deals ⟪0⟫ of ATK as Ignis Mark DMG.

habilidades.b: Unseals Evil Eye to deal AoE DMG, triggering ⟨Ignis Mark⟩ and generating Conflagration. After casting the Ultimate, Chaton enters the ⟨Evil Eye Unleashed⟩ state, gaining enhanced Auto Attacks, Super Armor, and increased Ultimate DMG and Movement SPD.

tpl.s: Unseals Evil Eye to inflict Cat Eye Mark on all nearby targets for 15s, then sweep fires, dealing ⟦0⟧ of ATK as AoE Ignis Ultimate DMG and detonating Cat Eye Marks to deal ⟦1⟧ of ATK as Ignis Ultimate DMG. Dark Evil Eye (Ultimate) can trigger ⟨Ignis Mark⟩, generating Conflagration: deals ⟪0⟫ of ATK as Ignis Mark DMG. After casting the Ultimate, Chaton enters the ⟨Evil Eye Unleashed⟩ state for 15s while gaining Super Armor, enhancing her Auto Attacks to Dark Burst, increasing her Ultimate DMG by 20% and her Movement SPD by 30%.

builds.d: A build that throw Bouncing Bombs to attack multiple targets.
A build that marks targets with a laser to deal continuous DMG to them.

l.b: Each time a Bouncing Bomb lands, it deals additional AoE DMG. Increases the Skill DMG dealt by the Bouncing Bomb.
l.s: Each time a Bouncing Bomb lands, it deals an additional ⟦0⟧ of ATK as AoE Ignis Skill DMG. Increases the Skill DMG dealt by the Bouncing Bomb by ⟦1⟧.

l.b: When holding the Main Skill button, Chaton throws more Bouncing Bombs. Increases the Skill DMG dealt by the Bouncing Bomb.
l.s: When holding Sniper Operation (Main Skill), Chaton throws ⟦0⟧ additional Bouncing Bombs. Increases the Skill DMG dealt by the Bouncing Bomb by ⟦1⟧.

l.b: When a Bouncing Bomb runs out of bounces, it returns to Chaton and grants her Spark. When holding the Main Skill button, consumes Spark to increase Chaton's Skill Crit DMG and deals additional DMG to the target.
l.s: When a Bouncing Bomb runs out of bounces, it returns to Chaton and grants her Spark. When holding Sniper Operation (Main Skill), Chaton consumes Spark to increase her Skill Crit DMG by ⟦0⟧ for 5s and throws an Explosive Bomb at the target, dealing ⟦1⟧ of ATK as AoE Ignis Skill DMG. The Explosive Bomb cannot bounce.

l.b: Increases a Bouncing Bomb's bounce count. Increases the ATK when a Bouncing Bomb deals DMG.
l.s: The Bouncing Bomb bounces 1 more time. Increases the ATK when a Bouncing Bomb deals DMG by ⟦0⟧.

l.b: Increases Bouncing Bomb's Crit DMG. When a Bouncing Bomb lands a Crit Hit, increases the Skill DMG the target takes from it.
l.s: Increases a Bouncing Bomb's Crit DMG by ⟦0⟧. When a Bouncing Bomb lands a Crit Hit, increases the Skill DMG the target takes from it by ⟦1⟧ for 10s, stacking up to 5 times.

l.b: Reduces Dark Mark's Attack Interval. Increases Chaton's Skill DMG to targets inflicted with Dark Mark.
l.s: Reduces Dark Mark's Attack Interval by ⟦0⟧. Increases Chaton's Skill DMG to targets inflicted with Dark Mark by ⟦1⟧.

l.b: Increases the Skill DMG dealt by ⟨Dark Ray⟩. Increases Dark Mark's DMG when the laser hits a target inflicted with Dark Mark.
l.s: Increases the Skill DMG dealt by ⟨Dark Ray⟩ by ⟦0⟧. Enhances Dark Mark when the laser hits a target inflicted with Dark Mark, increasing the DMG Multiplier dealt by Dark Mark by ⟦1⟧, stacking up to 3 times.

l.b: Increases the Skill DMG dealt by ⟨Dark Ray⟩. Chaton's Auto Attacks deal additional DMG to targets inflicted with Dark Mark.
l.s: Increases the Skill DMG dealt by ⟨Dark Ray⟩ by ⟦0⟧. Chaton's Auto Attack deals an additional ⟦1⟧ of ATK as Ignis Skill DMG to targets inflicted with Dark Mark. This effect can be triggered once per second.

l.b: Increases the Skill DMG of ⟨Dark Ray⟩. When the laser lands a Crit Hit, resets the Main Skill's Cooldown and increases the Skill DMG dealt by ⟨Dark Ray⟩.
l.s: Increases the Skill DMG of ⟨Dark Ray⟩ by ⟦0⟧. When the laser lands a Crit Hit, resets the Main Skill's Cooldown and increases the Skill DMG dealt by ⟨Dark Ray⟩ by ⟦1⟧ for 12s. This effect can be triggered once every 12s.

l.b: After Dark Mark lands a Crit Hit, increases the ATK of Dark Mark when it deals DMG.
l.s: After Dark Mark lands a Crit Hit, increases the ATK of Dark Mark when it deals DMG by ⟦0⟧ for 4s, stacking up to 10 times.

l.b: Activates the rapid-fire mode for Chaton's Auto Attack, increasing her attack frequency. When Chaton triggers a mark, increases her ATK.
l.s: Activates the rapid-fire mode for Chaton's Full-Auto Trigger (Auto Attack), increasing her attack frequency. When Chaton is in the ⟨Evil Eye Unleashed⟩ state, this effect changes to increasing her ATK SPD by 60%. When Chaton triggers a mark, increases her ATK by ⟦0⟧ for 5s, stacking up to 5 times.

l.b: Increases Chaton's dodges. When Chaton casts the Main Skill, increases her Ignis DMG.
l.s: Chaton can dodge one more time. When Chaton casts Sniper Operation (Main Skill), increases her Ignis DMG by ⟦0⟧ for 6s.

l.b: Increases Chaton's Ignis DMG dealt to targets with higher HP.
l.s: Increases Chaton's Ignis DMG dealt to targets with HP greater than 20% by ⟦0⟧.

l.b: The Ultimate and Dark Burst deal additional DMG to targets inflicted with Cat Eye Mark.
l.s: Dark Evil Eye (Ultimate) and Dark Burst (while ⟨Evil Eye Unleashed⟩ is active) deal an additional ⟦0⟧ of ATK as Ignis Ultimate DMG to targets inflicted with Cat Eye Mark.

l.b: Increases the duration of ⟨Evil Eye Unleashed⟩. Increases Chaton's Ultimate DMG. Allows bullets fired by Dark Burst to penetrate targets.
l.s: Increases the duration of ⟨Evil Eye Unleashed⟩ to 20s. Increases Chaton's Ultimate DMG by ⟦0⟧. Allows bullets fired by Dark Burst to penetrate targets.

l.b: Cat Eye Mark remains on the target after the Ultimate ends. Increases Chaton's Ignis DMG to targets inflicted with Cat Eye Mark.
l.s: Cat Eye Mark remains on the target after the Ultimate ends. Increases Chaton's Ignis DMG to targets inflicted with Cat Eye Mark by ⟦0⟧.

builds.d: A build that deals massive DMG over time to a single target.
A build that deals AoE DMG to multiple targets.

l.b: When each shot of the Support Skill hits its first target, deals additional DMG.
l.s: When each shot of Blitz Assault (Support Skill) hits its first target, inflicts Tier 1 Lock and deals an additional ⟦0⟧ of ATK as AoE Ignis Skill DMG. When a target is already inflicted with Tier 1 Lock, the effect upgrades to Tier 2 Lock, dealing ⟦1⟧ of ATK as AoE Ignis Skill DMG. When a target is already inflicted with Tier 2 Lock, the effect upgrades to Tier 3 Lock, dealing ⟦2⟧ of ATK as AoE Ignis Skill DMG.

l.n: Strike While the Iron is Hot
l.ne: Strike While the Iron is Hot
l.b: Increases the Skill DMG of the Support Skill. When Penetrating Bullet lands a Crit Hit, the Support Skill fires 1 additional shot.
l.s: Increases the Skill DMG of Blitz Assault (Support Skill) by ⟦0⟧. When Penetrating Bullet lands a Crit Hit, Blitz Assault (Support Skill) fires 1 additional shot. This effect can be triggered ⟦1⟧ times per Support Skill cast.

l.b: Increases the Skill DMG of the Support Skill. When casting the Support Skill, Evil Eye locks onto the target's current position, dealing AoE DMG over time.
l.s: Increases the Skill DMG of Blitz Assault (Support Skill) by ⟦0⟧. When casting the Support Skill, Evil Eye locks onto the target's current position, dealing ⟦1⟧ of ATK as AoE Ignis Skill DMG every 0.4s for 8s.

l.b: Increases the Skill DMG Chaton deals to targets inflicted with Lock.
l.s: Increases the Skill DMG Chaton deals to targets inflicted with Lock, increasing ⟦0⟧ for each tier of Lock.

l.b: While the Support Skill is active, increases the Ignis DMG dealt by Chaton to the current target over time.
l.s: While Blitz Assault (Support Skill) is active, increases the Ignis DMG dealt by Chaton to the current target by ⟦0⟧ per second, stacking up to 10 times.

l.b: Increases the Skill DMG dealt by Blitz Assault (Support Skill). Each time the Support Skill fires, shoots more Penetrating Bullets.
l.s: Increases the Skill DMG dealt by Blitz Assault (Support Skill) by ⟦0⟧. Each time the Support Skill fires, shoots ⟦1⟧ additional Penetrating Bullets.

l.b: Increases the Skill DMG of the Support Skill. When Penetrating Bullet deals DMG, it splits into many Small Penetrating Bullets that also deal DMG.
l.s: Increases the Skill DMG of Blitz Assault (Support Skill) by ⟦0⟧. When Penetrating Bullet deals DMG, it splits into ⟦1⟧ Small Penetrating Bullets, dealing ⟦2⟧ of ATK as Ignis Skill DMG. It splits up to 3 times per Tumbling Shot.

l.b: Increases Chaton's Skill DMG. Each time the Support Skill fires, shoots additional Meow Bombs, dealing DMG.
l.s: Increases Chaton's Skill DMG by ⟦0⟧. Each time Blitz Assault (Support Skill) fires, shoots 2 additional Meow Bombs. The bombs shoot forward in a straight line 3 times, dealing ⟦1⟧ of ATK as AoE Ignis Skill DMG each time.

l.b: The Support Skill instantly eliminates normal targets with low HP. Increases the Ignis DMG dealt to elite or boss targets with low HP.
l.s: Blitz Assault (Support Skill) instantly eliminates normal targets with HP below 30%. Increases the Ignis DMG dealt to elite or boss targets with HP below 80% by ⟦0⟧.

l.b: When the Support Skill lands a Crit Hit, increases the Skill DMG it deals.
l.s: When Blitz Assault (Support Skill) lands a Crit Hit, increases the Skill DMG it deals by ⟦0⟧, stacking up to 5 times.

l.b: Increases the ATK of Ignis Trekkers in the squad.
l.s: Increases the ATK of Ignis Trekkers in the squad by ⟦0⟧.

l.b: When Chaton's Energy is full, increases her Skill DMG.
l.s: When Chaton's Energy is full, increases her Skill DMG by ⟦0⟧ for 20s.

l.b: While Blitz Assault (Support Skill) is active, increases Chaton's Skill DMG.
l.s: While Blitz Assault (Support Skill) is active, increases Chaton's Skill DMG by ⟦0⟧.

l.b: The Ultimate and Dark Burst deal additional DMG to targets inflicted with Cat Eye Mark.
l.s: Dark Evil Eye (Ultimate) and Dark Burst (while ⟨Evil Eye Unleashed⟩ is active) deal an additional ⟦0⟧ of ATK as Ignis Ultimate DMG to targets inflicted with Cat Eye Mark.

l.b: Increases the duration of ⟨Evil Eye Unleashed⟩. Increases Chaton's Ultimate DMG. Allows bullets fired by Dark Burst to penetrate targets.
l.s: Increases the duration of ⟨Evil Eye Unleashed⟩ to 20s. Increases Chaton's Ultimate DMG by ⟦0⟧. Allows bullets fired by Dark Burst to penetrate targets.

l.b: Cat Eye Mark remains on the target after the Ultimate ends. Increases Chaton's Ignis DMG to targets inflicted with Cat Eye Mark.
l.s: Cat Eye Mark remains on the target after the Ultimate ends. Increases Chaton's Ignis DMG to targets inflicted with Cat Eye Mark by ⟦0⟧.
